context: Investigate the evidence in this file. I want a timeline, when initial access happened, any compromised accounts, lateral movement, persistence, and c2, data access or exfil
motivation: Targeted data theft and credential harvesting — attacker achieved domain Administrator access to C137.local before Sep 18 2020, conducted DCSync to extract all domain hashes (F-003), accessed the FileShare\Secret directory containing proprietary files ("Szechuan Sauce.txt", "PortalGunPlans.txt") via RDP (F-014), exfiltrated 39MB to attacker-controlled OneDrive at 02:37 UTC Sep 19 (F-011), and installed a custom C2 implant (coreupdater.exe, F-005/F-006) on both the domain controller and workstation for persistent access; no destructive payload or ransomware observed.
